## Should We Invest in Solar?

<p class="sample-course-subtitle">Capital Budgeting, Sensitivity Analysis, and Managerial Judgement in Excel</p>
:::

::: {.sample-course-video .ratio .ratio-16x9}
<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/nHSyLciFe1k" title="Introduction to Should We Invest in Solar?" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"></iframe>
:::

::: {.sample-course-description}
Take the role of a junior commercial analyst at a South African manufacturing company. Compare three competing solar proposals by building and testing an Excel financial model, examining assumptions and supplier claims, then preparing an evidence-based recommendation. The spreadsheet develops analytical competence; choosing what the evidence supports calls for managerial judgement.
:::
